one_sentence_story: One source-bound paper claim travels as a single luminous edge through a transparent context capsule, becomes an event-ordered torus braid with a cusp hexagonal fibre, and closes only when a source receipt and a measured world snapshot remain visible beside it.

beats.causal_move: Ask the question before naming the abstraction.
beats.visual: A single warm paper artifact enters from the left and locks to a small source pin. The black field stays empty except for the question.
on_screen: WHAT DOES THE CHAIN ACTUALLY PROVE?
beats.voiceover: Before we draw a world, ask what the record can actually support.

beats.causal_move: Turn the source pointer into one visible evidence stream.
beats.visual: A thin amber-white stream grows from the pinned artifact, with a stable origin marker. No counter, dashboard, or extra object appears.
beats.voiceover: The source does not become truth; it becomes a trace that can be followed.
beats.receipt: 02 Projects/Sistem-Insa/G-HERAKLES-FILM-FACTORY/canonical/master-production-chain.v1.json: every visible claim has a pointer

beats.causal_move: Make context explicit without changing the trace identity.
beats.visual: The stream passes through a transparent rectangular Context Capsule. Its glass edges brighten; the same origin marker remains on the stream and the paper artifact remains in frame.
beats.voiceover: Context can explain a record without silently upgrading it into a consensus fact.

beats.causal_move: Encode event order as a visual braid, then expose its boundary.
beats.visual: The stream folds into three concentric torus rings. At the only active cusp, one ring opens into a six-sided fibre; all non-active rails dim. The fibre is a visual model, not a measured topology result.
beats.voiceover: The film gives event order a shape: a family of loops with one readable exit, not a decorative system diagram.

beats.causal_move: Close the claim only at the receipt and world-trace boundary.
beats.visual: The hexagonal fibre docks into a quiet receipt plate on the right. The paper artifact, stream origin, capsule, torus family, and fibre all remain visible. A measured snapshot line appears below the claim; no invented event id is added.
on_screen: EON MAY SERVE AS AN ORDINAL/EVENT-BASED SURFACE FOR THE REMAINING-EDGE COUNTER
beats.voiceover: The paper claim closes as a claim: EON may hold the remaining-edge counter in event order. The receipt bounds the scene; it does not prove the world is true.

construction: Create all five persistent objects once in construct(); keep source_artifact and origin marker in the scene for the full run.
Use a fixed CubicBezierPath for evidence_stream; animate only a Dot and a growing stroke along that path.
Build context_capsule from transparent Prism faces with fixed opacity; never replace it with a UI panel.
Build torus_family from ParametricSurface torus meshes at fixed radii 1.45, 1.85, and 2.25; rotate each with fixed phase offsets 0, 0.18, and 0.36 radians.
At beat 4, morph only the active rail into a fixed RegularPolygon(n=6) fibre at the cusp; dim the other rails to 0.58 opacity.
At beat 5, write only measured source and snapshot labels from the candidate constants; render the claim label in a separate text group with PAPER CLAIM prefix.
Run with --quality h and -r 1672,941; use no random seed, live network call, or ImageGen pixel as a data input.
acceptance_checks: each beat contains exactly one causal_move
source_artifact, evidence_stream, context_capsule, torus_family, and cusp_hexagonal_fibre persist through the closing frame
final frame contains PAPER CLAIM and a source/world receipt
no numeric counter is invented; only eon_layers=4 and receipts=2 are copied from the measured world-bound source
ImageGen reference is used only for visual grammar
